controls.objective: Reject newly created privileged containers and containers permitting privilege escalation.
controls.coverage: Regular and init containers on Pod CREATE; privileged=false and explicit allowPrivilegeEscalation=false.
limits: Does not implement the full Restricted Pod Security Standard, runAsNonRoot, capabilities, seccomp or ephemeral-container controls.
dependencies: Admission-controller availability and failure policy reviewed
platform_evidence: Positive and negative CREATE requests on the target API server
Existing-workload response and debug-subresource restrictions reviewed
controls.rollback: Move this control to Audit or restore its previous revision; assess each workload before replacement.

controls.objective: Constrain new workload connections while preserving approved dependencies.
controls.coverage: Checks the Pod egress-profile label on CREATE/UPDATE.
limits: A label check does not enforce connectivity.
Changing network policy can affect existing connections differently across CNIs.
dependencies: CNI enforces namespace and workload NetworkPolicies
Approved DNS, database and observability paths are documented
platform_evidence: Allowed and denied connection probes on the target CNI
Availability floor and evidence collection remain healthy
controls.rollback: Restore the approved network and admission revision; rerun connectivity and availability probes.

controls.objective: Route requirements beyond this admission compiler to their actual enforcement owner.
controls.coverage: Explicit unsupported requirement; no policy or security success is inferred.
limits: Reads, tool calls, evidence capture and existing processes require other enforcement layers.
dependencies: Named requirement owner and enforcement component
platform_evidence: Requirement-specific positive and negative runtime or application test
controls.rollback: Restore the reviewed enforcement component according to its own playbook.

controls.objective: Reduce the compromised identity's effective Kubernetes API permissions.
controls.coverage: Review-only requirement; this compiler does not render RBAC changes.
limits: Token automount settings do not revoke already exposed credentials.
Admission does not observe get/list/watch operations.
platform_evidence: Positive and negative authorization tests for the actual principal
controls.rollback: Restore only reviewed minimum permissions and verify intended reads and denied writes.

parameters.note: Requires RBAC and ServiceAccount changes beyond admission control.

controls.objective: Limit image sources for newly created or changed regular containers.
controls.coverage: Registry prefix on regular-container images on Pod CREATE and image-changing UPDATE.
limits: Registry allowlisting does not verify signatures or provenance.
Init and ephemeral container images are not covered by this template.
Mutable tags and existing image compromise need separate controls.
dependencies: Registry reachability, authentication and mirror availability
platform_evidence: Init/ephemeral coverage, digest pinning and signature verification disposition
controls.rollback: Restore the approved registry list or previous policy revision after reviewing image provenance.

exception_limits_basis: Proposed reference limits; enterprise owners must ratify them. No exception is granted.
